verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Bitwarden's integrated authenticator automatically generates rotating TOTP codes once a key/QR is added to a login item (bitwarden-docs-1, bitwarden-docs-13), which covers the core capability, but the pack lacks explicit documentation of the actual camera-scan-QR flow for a brand-new account (only QR-based *import* from another authenticator app is documented, bitwarden-docs-3/14). One community report also describes difficulty getting TOTP working at all (bitwarden-comm-12), though it's anecdotal and not a concrete reproducible failure. missing for 10: explicit doc/screenshot of scanning a QR to add a brand-new TOTP secret (not import), and independent hands-on confirmation that codes generate immediately after scan.
